name: Killer Drone
description: Deploys a drone onto any tile up to %cast_range% tiles away for %duration% turns. It has no attack you can order, but strikes a random enemy within %strike_range% tile at the end of every turn.
details: Drones never block movement, and nothing standing in the way blocks them either - they fly over units and deploy onto occupied tiles.
An enemy sharing the drone's own tile counts as being in reach.

upgrade.summary: Drones never run out of fuel - they stay until something shoots them down.
upgrade.description: Deploys a drone onto any tile up to %cast_range% tiles away, where it stays indefinitely. It has no attack you can order, but strikes a random enemy within %strike_range% tile at the end of every turn.
details: Drones never block movement, and nothing standing in the way blocks them either - they fly over units and deploy onto occupied tiles.
An enemy sharing the drone's own tile counts as being in reach.
With no duration to run down, every drone deployed is a drone that is still out there.
